name: Razzberry Diesel Fire Styxx | 1G
description: From Glorious Cannabis, Fire Styxx lineup offers an extreme value to the top selling infused pre-rolls on the market! A great opportunity to try these highly regarded THCA infused pre-rolls! Tart yet refreshing, with strong flavors of red ripe raspberry, and undertones of earthy pine pack a punch in Razzberry Diesel. Slow burn. Better high.
